# Cambridge Cancer Trials Centre

A UK clinical trials centre. This GitHub organisation hosts software
developed by our in-house team — predominantly a closed estate of
internal clinical-trial systems, plus a small set of open-source
REDCap External Modules.

## REDCap External Modules

The repositories below are published for the wider REDCap community.
Bug reports and pull requests are welcome — see each repository for
installation notes, contribution guidance, and licence terms.

| Module | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [`data_entry_log`](https://github.com/CCTC-team/data_entry_log) | Review and query recently entered data, filtered by form- or field-level changes. |
| [`configuration_monitor`](https://github.com/CCTC-team/configuration_monitor) | Monitors changes to project settings, user roles, and system settings; sends email notifications on modification. |
| [`monitoring_qr`](https://github.com/CCTC-team/monitoring_qr) | A monitoring workflow built on REDCap's Data Resolution Workflow, kept independent of the main data-resolution flow. |
| [`enhance_reason_for_change`](https://github.com/CCTC-team/enhance_reason_for_change) | Extends the built-in reason-for-change process with extra configuration. |
| [`enhance_form_status`](https://github.com/CCTC-team/enhance_form_status) | Role-based restrictions and automated oversight on the built-in form-complete field. |
| [`highlight_dq_rules`](https://github.com/CCTC-team/highlight_dq_rules) | Surfaces real-time data-quality rule errors on data-entry screens for selected user roles. |
| [`embellish_fields`](https://github.com/CCTC-team/embellish_fields) | Displays extra per-field information beneath the field label. |
| [`versioning`](https://github.com/CCTC-team/versioning) | Versioning support for REDCap projects to help manage amendments. |

## Other repositories

Repositories not listed above are internal CCTC engineering systems.
They are not designed for external contribution and most are private.

## Reporting a security issue

Please do not open public issues for security-sensitive matters. See
[`SECURITY.md`](https://github.com/CCTC-team/.github/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
for the org-wide vulnerability reporting policy.
